title: lathyrus aureus
intro: Lathyrus aureus, commonly known as the golden pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable plant for treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus aureus include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
